def resolve(request: dict[str, Any], dictionaries: DictionarySet) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Resolve a modern caller request without network access.

    Accepted request fields: ``id`` (modern or legacy id) or ``text``.
    The return value always reports ``egress_performed=False``; this function
    has no transport dependency.
    """
    word_id = request.get("id")
    text = normalize_text(request.get("text"))

    entry = None
    lookup_kind = None
    if word_id is not None:
        word_id = str(word_id)
        entry = dictionaries.by_id.get(word_id)
        if entry is not None:
            lookup_kind = "modern_id"
        if entry is None:
            entry = dictionaries.by_legacy_id.get(word_id)
            if entry is not None:
                lookup_kind = "legacy_id"
    if entry is None and text:
        entry = dictionaries.by_query.get(text)
        if entry is not None:
            lookup_kind = "text"

    if entry is None:
        return {
            "status": "not_found",
            "query": request.get("text") or word_id,
            "lookup_kind": lookup_kind or "unresolved",
            "canonical": None,
            "word_id": None,
            "legacy_id": None,
            "dictionary_version": None,
            "egress_performed": False,
        }

    source = next(
        (d for d in dictionaries.dictionaries if any(e.id == entry.id for e in d.entries)),
        None,
    )
    return {
        "status": "ok",
        "query": entry.query,
        "lookup_kind": lookup_kind,
        "canonical": entry.canonical,
        "word_id": entry.id,
        "legacy_id": entry.legacy_id,
        "source_list": source.list_id if source else None,
        "dictionary_version": source.version if source else None,

    }

"""Native legacy-word-number implementation for the Qianzi branch.

This is not a copy of the mainline reviewed resolver.  It is the branch
maintainer's own implementation and therefore needs branch-scoped validation
and a branch-only endorsement.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import re
from typing import Any

from mojiao.dictionary import DictionarySet

OLD_WORD_ID = re.compile(r"^\d{4}$")


def resolve(request: dict[str, Any], dictionaries: DictionarySet) -> dict[str, Any]:
    code = str(request.get("word_id") or request.get("id") or "").strip()
    if not OLD_WORD_ID.fullmatch(code):
        return {
            "status": "contract_error",
            "word_id": code or None,
            "canonical": None,
            "egress_performed": False,
            "error": "caller/legacy-wordid-v1 requires a four-digit word_id",
        }

    entry = dictionaries.by_legacy_id.get(code)
    if entry is None:
        return {
            "status": "old_id_not_found",
            "word_id": code,
            "canonical": None,
            "egress_performed": False,
        }

    source = next(
        (d for d in dictionaries.dictionaries if any(e.id == entry.id for e in d.entries)),
        None,
    )
    return {
        "status": "ok",
        "word_id": code,
        "internal_word_id": entry.id,
        "canonical": entry.canonical,
        "query": entry.query,
        "source_list": source.list_id if source else None,
        "dictionary_version": source.version if source else None,
        "egress_performed": False,
        "implementation": "native_legacy",
    }


# Explicit contract name used in review records.
resolve_code = resolve

    legacy_code = str(request.get("word_id") or request.get("id") or "").strip()
    entry = dictionaries.by_legacy_id.get(legacy_code)
    modern_id = entry.id if entry is not None and entry.id.startswith("W-") else None

    modern_request = {"id": modern_id} if modern_id else {"id": legacy_code}
    result = reviewed_resolve(modern_request, dictionaries)
    result["boundary"] = "compat_oldid_v1"
    result["requested_legacy_id"] = legacy_code
    if result.get("status") == "ok":
        result["word_id"] = legacy_code
    return result
